notes: The complete independent second reading proposes three punctuation corrections and one certainty-only reopening. No missing inventory element was found; all 31 listed elements are accounted for.

The outer marginal note reads first de l’endom followed by underlined ext., then comme endom followed on the next short line by ext, en dépend. Only the three unwritten abbreviation points are removed. The later endom. ord. points remain. Each corrected occurrence is reported with the exact affected witness wording.

All 30 previously unresolved live, inserted, deleted and marginal places remain marked. The possible opening parenthesis at 47 adds one reopened doubt, M0401, bringing the audit's explicit doubt inventory to 31. No new readable completion is asserted for the densely crossed marginal prose.

The preliminary canceled row remains tentative pts plus two unreadable words. The longer canceled block retains its tentative Si, groupoid, prose and formula fragments. The clearer final (48 bis) formula remains canceled; it is not used to repair the live argument.

The note below (49) retains the unprimed final Pi0 and its unclosed parenthesis. Its initial acting Pi0-prime remains primed. The source is not normalized to the stronger algebraic statement discussed in the existing root notes.

The current root proof notes 142-094-R1, R2 and R3 were read as supplied apparatus. This audit performs no independent mathematical re-proof and records no mathematical check event.
No author page number is visible. The lighter thin archive folio 93 is retained as another unnamed hand. It creates no macro-only or substantive comparison row.
